<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % param "<!-- internal parameter entity comment -->">
  %param;
  <!ENTITY ent "Resolved Entity">
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
]>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns1" xmlns:ns2="http://example.com/ns2">
  <!-- Top-level commentary block emphasizing mixed content and namespace usage -->
  <ns2:child id="node1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing markup-like strings: <child>&ent;</child>
    ]]>
  </ns2:child>
  <?target-pi data="test-value"?>
  <child>&ent;</child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item+)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY company "ACME Corp">
  <!ENTITY % dtdMacro "<!ENTITY secret 'Confidential Payload'>">
  %dtdMacro;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  <?pi-node target="init" status="active"?>
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://catalog.org/ns" xmlns:custom="http://catalog.org/custom">
  <!-- Multi-namespace container with comments and CDATA -->
  <custom:item>
    <?custom-pi action="parse"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Some raw CDATA text with entities: &company; - &secret;
    ]]>
  </custom:item>
  <item>&secret;</item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record)*>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "BaseEntity">
  <!ENTITY extended "&base; Expanded">
  <!ENTITY % extDecl "<!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA | sub)*>">
  %extDecl;
  <!ELEMENT sub (#PCDATA)>
  <?archive-meta version="2.0"?>
]>
<archive xmlns="http://archive.org/schema" xmlns:x="http://archive.org/x">
  <!-- Archive description block with dense comments -->
  <record x:id="rec-01">
    <![CDATA[
      Archive CDATA payload containing &extended; and other tags <sub/>
    ]]>
  </record>
  <sub xmlns:x="http://archive.org/sub">&extended;</sub>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section*)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY refA "Reference A">
  <!ENTITY refB "&refA; and Reference B">
  <!ENTITY % entityMacro "<!ENTITY dynamicEnt 'Dynamic Content'>">
  %entityMacro;
  <?xml-log level="debug" target="stdout"?>
]>
<document xmlns="http://doc.org/ns" xmlns:meta="http://doc.org/meta">
  <!-- Document root containing processing instructions and CDATA sections -->
  <meta:section id="s1">
    <?meta-action type="process"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Nested CDATA block: &dynamicEnt; with <meta:tag> elements.
    ]]>
  </meta:section>
  <section>&refB;</section>
</document>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE system [
  <!ELEMENT system (node)*>
  <!ELEMENT node (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY sysEnt "System Entity">
  <!ENTITY % paramEnt "<!ENTITY nestedEnt '&sysEnt; Nested'>">
  %paramEnt;
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY manual SYSTEM "manual.pdf" NDATA pdf>
  <?system-cfg mode="secure"?>
]>
<system xmlns="http://system.org/ns" xmlns:sys="http://system.org/sys">
  <!-- Root system container combining all rare constructs -->
  <sys:node id="node-alpha">
    <?sys-pi command="verify"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Critical section with CDATA &nestedEnt; and literal tags <node/>
    ]]>
  </sys:node>
  <node>&nestedEnt;</node>
</system>
```
